mathematics.assertion_tested: The 19 explicitly named arithmetic assertions encoded in review_examples.py agree with independent calculations from the displayed definitions at their stated finite rows, degrees, residue moduli and matrix sizes.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Python unbounded integers and fractions.Fraction; residue enumeration over Z/2^L; exact rational formal-series coefficients.
mathematics.conventions: Sequences start at row zero. Euler numbers use sech(t), signed even coefficients. EGF decoding multiplies by (2n)! or (6n)!. v_p(0) is represented by None as mathematical infinity. Integer residues use least nonnegative representatives. Matrix coordinates are in the printed row/column order. All operations are exact.
inputs: Hard-coded displayed reciprocal, dyadic source/kernel, polynomial, coordinate-conjugation and recurrence definitions inside that independently authored script.
non_claims: No universal theorem is proved by these bounded calculations.
No fresh Lean or Lake invocation occurs.
No floating-point, tolerance-based or probabilistic arithmetic is used.
Formal coefficient agreement does not establish analytic convergence.
Finite residue candidates are not exact p-adic roots.
The runtime result certifies the encoded cases, not every figure or sentence in the guide.
